simple.meaning: permanence ; hence (concrete) permanent ; specifically a chieftain
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֵיתָן (H386) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 13 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֵיתָן (ʼêythân) means permanence ; hence (concrete) permanent ; specifically a chieftain First listed occurrence: Amos 5 24.

definitions.short: permanence ; hence (concrete) permanent ; specifically a chieftain
definitions.full: H386. ethan I. אֵתָן אֵיתָן, adjective perennial, ever-flowing , figurative permanent, as substantive steady flow, permanence; — absolute אֵיתָן Gen 49:24 8 t.; אֵתָן Job 33:19 ; suffix אֵיתָנוֺ Exod 14:27 ; plural אֵיתָנִים Job 12:19 ; אֵתָנִים 1Kin 8:2 ; Micah 6:2 ; (in form, an 'elative,' Ew § 162 b = Arabic comparative and superlative); — 1 ever-flowing (opposed to אַכְזָב ), אֵיתָן נַחַל Amos 5:24 an ever-flowing wady, Deut 21:4 (see Dr); as substantive in אֵיתָּן נַהֲרוֺת Psa 74:15 rivers of steady flow ; as substantive also Exod 14:27 (J), the sea returned לְאֵיתָנוֺ to its steady flow , הָאֵיתָנִים יֶרַת 1Kin 8:2 month of steady flowings = 7th mo., Oct.-;Nov. (post-Biblical Tisri). 2 figurative permanent, enduring הוּא אֵיתָן גּוֺי Jer 5:15 , i.e. a nation whose numbers never dwindle or fail, imperishable , א עֲצָמָיו ׳וְרִיב Job 33:19 Kt the strife of his bones is constant , Gen 49:24 his bow abode ׳בְּא as an enduring, firm , one, ׳א מוֺשָֽׁבְךָ Num 24:21 (|| בַּסֶּלַע שִׂים ), אֵיתָן נְוֵה Jer 49:19 = 50:44 an abode of permanency (of Edom, and Babylon, suddenly depopulated by foe, figured as lion); ארץ מוסדי האיתנים Micah 6:2 ye ever-enduring ones, the foundations of the earth (but read probably with We הַאֲזִינוּ ), Job 12:19 יְסַלֵּף אֵיתָנִים he subverteth them that are firmly seated (i.e. men established in hereditary offices or dignities). Very uncertain is Prov 13:15 אֵיתָן בִּגְדִים דֶּרֶךְ , perhaps firm, hard, rugged (Ew De Hi Now according to Str. the text is corrupt).
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) אֵתָן ; from an unused root (meaning to continue );
